target: AArch64 QEMU virt, one vCPU, graphical terminal and window manager
command: QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 scripts/check-compat.py --pci --probe-demo-wallpapers
verified: Guest startup and graphical terminal/window-manager checks passed.
SysFile loaded WallPaperStars.ZC and returned to the command prompt.
The window manager remained active and reported presented_frames in zstatus.
The first wallpaper capture differed from the boot baseline by 101356 pixels.
failed: Two scanout captures 350 ms apart were identical (frames_diff=0), although WallPaperStars increments star positions on each callback.
not_verified: Whether the wallpaper callback runs and mutates its star state; the current acceptance harness only captured scanout and did not inspect wall_stars[].
WallPaperFish and WallPaperCtrl, because the combined check stops on the Stars animation failure.
scope_note: This is evidence of a visible animation failure in the guest scanout path, not proof that the source fails to compile or that its callback is not called. The next diagnostic should compare wall_stars state across forced window-manager refreshes, then distinguish callback scheduling from framebuffer composition/presentation.
